title: Principal Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (GCP)
description:
Job Title: Principal Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (GCP)
Job Location: Work at Home, Rhode Island, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

GCP Platform Technical Lead

Position Summary

We are looking for a GCP Principal Engineer to lead our Cloud Engineering team, owning the Google Cloud Platform for the enterprise. This is a foundational platform role - you are the GCP technical authority, setting architectural/engineeringdirection,establishingengineering standards, and ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, and built to last.

Your role will include driving designs of the platform, mentoringthe engineers around you, andaligningquality and best practices. You bring deep GCPexpertise, a platform-owner mindset, and the leadership presence to align engineers and stakeholders around a shared technical vision.This role demands a  cloud-first thinker  who ensures cloud solutions meet business needs efficiently while prioritizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to create repeatable, automated deployments. You need to have a proventrack recordof  architecting cloud environments from scratch .You'lldrive cloud transformation initiativesall CSP’s focusing on theGCP platformwhile ensuring every design decision considers security, reliability, and scalability.

This is not a hands-off leadership role - you write code, review designs, and stay close to the work.

Major Responsibilities

1. GCP Platform Ownership

• Own the enterprise GCP platform end-to-end: organization structure, resource hierarchy, networking architecturewhile collaborating with several teams to ensure the platform is stable and compliant.

• Define andmaintainthe GCP landing zone - Shared VPC, Org Policies,and project factory patterns - as the foundation all product teams build on.

• Serve as theone of thefinal technical authoritieson GCPengineeringdecisions, reviewing designs for scalability, security, and operational excellence before they reach production.

• Build self-service platform capabilities that enable product engineering teams to move fast without compromising standards.

2. Technical Team Leadership

• Lead theGCPcloud engineering team as the technical anchor - set direction, conduct design reviews, unblock engineers, and drive delivery on platform initiatives.

• Establish and enforce engineering standards:IaCpatterns, naming conventions, tagging strategy, branching models, and deployment practices.

• Mentor engineers at all levels, building depth on the team and raising the bar on what “excellence” looks like in cloud engineering.

• Partner with architecture, security, operations, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into platform capabilities.

3. Infrastructure as Code & Automation

• Drive Infrastructure as code as a coreprinciple -reusable modules, pipeline integration, state management, and policy guardrails.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, and Artifact Registry for both platform infrastructure and application teams.

• Write production-quality automation to extend platform functionality, integrate GCP APIs, andeliminateoperational toil.

• Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Config Connector, and GCP Org Policies to enforce governance at scale without manual gatekeeping.

4. Networking, Security & Compliance

• Architect/EngineerGCP networking: Shared VPC, VPC Service Controls, Private Service Connect,NCC,CloudNAT,and hybrid connectivity via Cloud Interconnect and HA VPN.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

At Astronomer, we’re redefining how companies run Apache Airflow at scale. Our R&D organization is home to some of the most innovative minds in cloud infrastructure and open-source software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You get to go in at the ground level of how our production infrastructure is designed, built, tested and deployed. Your work will directly influence how we build Astro, Observe and our IDE product, as well as how global organizations orchestrate data pipelines at scale-making them faster, more reliable, and easier to manage. If you’re driven by impact, excited by scale, and ready to work on the kind of infrastructure challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud-native systems, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO:

- Make high-quality, data-driven and experience-driven decisions on how we build this and the next generation of our production platform, then deliver the results.

- Own and build how we test, build and deploy code in a high-scale PaaS environment.

- Collaborate across the whole company on how we design production systems, set standards and make technology choices for new and existing products, and how these fit together.

- Deliver results - we routinely “change the wheels on the bus while it’s moving”, in a predictable, safe and reliable way.

- Be at the forefront of how we work together as a Platform Engineering team.

- Blaze a Trail: Work on a small but growing team on building out the Platform/Reliability practice for the company

- Be an Owner: Be directly involved in decision-making on what we work on, as well as how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.

- Do Sensible Things: Be directly involved in determining how our platform works. Participate in incident management and determine sensible practices as the platform evolves.

- Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation for systems and processes, ensuring clarity and accessibility.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE:

- Strong experience in Non-Abstract Systems design https://sre.google/workbook/non-abstract-design/ and implementation.

- Strong proficiency in Python, Golang and in-depth experience with Kubernetes (CKA or equivalent or greater).

- Experience with observability principles and technologies, including SLI/SLO definition and tracking.

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in working with a globally distributed team in delivery.

- A passion for reliability and operational excellence. A low tolerance for toil and other nonsense.

- Ability to estimate the scope of work accurately and coordinate with stakeholders to address risks and ensure successful project delivery.

- Experience with (and ideally strong opinions on) software development best practices, such as code review, testing, CI/CD, version control, automation and debugging.

- Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues, with a focus on ownership and accountability.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

- Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.

- Experience with our particular tech stack components and technologies (deep breath): CircleCI, Chronosphere (Prometheus), Splunk, Bazel, Istio, Playwright, Karpenter, Github [Actions] …

- Experience of the innards and quirks of AWS, GCP and (particularly) Azure.

- Participated in an on-call rotation

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an anti-IFN-β monoclonal antibody. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit JadeBiosciences.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Role Overview
Jade is developing potentially transformational, disease-modifying therapies for people living with autoimmune diseases. With three biologics programs in the clinic and multiple ongoing studies from Phase I to Phase III, we are seeking an experienced Executive Director, Clinical Supply Management to join our CMC leadership team and make sure every patient in our trials receives the right investigational product, on time.
Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (Head of CMC), you will own clinical supply strategy, planning and execution for all Jade programs. You will shape and scale the Clinical Supply Management function, growing and mentoring a team of internal employees and contractors, and you will lead a global network of CMOs and logistics partners supporting complex, multi-country and multi-site studies with ambitious timelines and enrollment targets.
This is a high-impact role for a self-starter who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a member of Column’s Business Operations team, you will be responsible for helping lay the foundation for the company’s next decade of growth. This team will own Column’s most important strategic and operational initiatives, with a heavy focus on designing new operating systems that will directly impact our ability to scale. Individuals in this role will serve as the “GM” of a particular product or project, diving deep into a wide range of challenges, while working alongside senior leadership at Column to take our business to the next level.

This position will be based in our San Francisco office in the Presidio, with regular travel throughout the United Sates. You can expect to be on the road 50%+ of the time, often embedded on-site for 2-4 weeks at a time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the strategy and operations for our most critical scaling initiatives

- Find the biggest bottlenecks to scale, then design and ship the products and workflows that remove them

- Drive decisions around “build vs. buy” strategies for new tooling and systems we need to drive automation and scale

- Spend time on-site with operators to understand workflows firsthand and turn what you learn into product and operational decisions

- Own execution end to end, driving timelines, alignment, and accountability on execution across the team

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

- 7+ years of experience in strategy and business operations in a high-growth environment; prior experience at a top-tier management consulting firm strongly preferred

- Ability to jump into new situations and quickly solve problems, with an eye toward architecting solutions that will scale

- Experience influencing and managing multiple stakeholders with varying priorities, and getting them to commit to executing against a shared goal

- Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical

- Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

- Familiarity with the banking and fintech industries is preferred, but not required - an interest in becoming an expert in this space, however, is a must

WHAT YOU'LL GET FROM US

- 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!

POSITION OVERVIEW

This role is responsible for maintaining and maturing Momentive's enterprise-wide third-party risk program, ensuring that all vendors, platforms, and service providers meet the Firm's cybersecurity, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory requirements.
The Analyst partners closely with Client Success, Cybersecurity Engineering, TVM, Legal, Procurement, Product, and the CISO to evaluate vendor risk, maintain continuous oversight of third-party controls, and support Momentive's compliance obligations - including SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS. The role also supports TVM notifications to clients who manage their own cybersecurity posture, ensuring clear, accurate, and timely communication of vulnerabilities and remediation expectations.
This position requires strong analytical capability, deep familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, and the ability to translate complex risk issues into actionable guidance for business and technical stakeholders.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Third-Party Risk Management Program

• Maintain Momentive's global inventory of third-party providers, applications, and services from onboarding through termination.

• Lead vendor cybersecurity assessments, coordinating with Cybersecurity Engineering, Legal, and business owners to evaluate risk and required controls.

• Assess vendor maturity using NIST CSF, CIS, CMMC, GDPR, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other frameworks.

• Oversee vendor SLAs, RPO/RTO commitments, breach notification requirements, and cybersecurity insurance documentation.

• Ensure thorough documentation of findings, recommendations, and remediation plans for all vendor assessments.

• Serve as a liaison to internal and external auditors for vendor-related controls and evidence collection.

By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.
We are looking for someone who is curious and practical in using AI and technology to improve day-to-day work, streamline processes and support attorneys more efficiently.
This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.
What You’ll Do

•
The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. Travel end to end, including the changes in flight and the reconciliation afterwards.

•
The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.

•
The documents. Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you.

•
Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.

•
How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.

• Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively

• Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration

• Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system - or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Observe by Snowflake
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built natively on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Its Telemetry Lakehouse Foundation enables organizations to ingest, retain, and analyze massive volumes of telemetry more economically than traditional observability platforms while keeping data reusable across analytics and AI through open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. Its Observability Context Graph captures relationships across services, infrastructure, logs, metrics, and traces, providing the semantic context needed to reason about complex systems. A programmable AI SRE automates investigation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate incident resolution.

Trusted by engineering teams at organizations including Capital One, HPE, and Breeze Airways, Observe ingests and analyzes hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining enterprise-scale reliability. Observe joined Snowflake through its acquisition in February 2026.

The Infrastructure team at Observe by Snowflake is responsible for architecting, scaling, and operating the development and production environments that power our observability platform. We are a small, highly collaborative team with broad scope and high ownership, focused on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure while continuously evolving the systems that support our engineers and customers.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping our infrastructure strategy, driving architectural decisions, and elevating operational excellence across the organization. Examples of the work you'd take on include launching single-tenant and multi-tenant environments for new customers on tight timelines, migrating our Kubernetes ingress from Ingress-NGINX to Envoy and the Gateway API, shifting our release process from script-driven lockstep weekly deploys to GitOps with ArgoCD, and building repeatable processes for infrastructure upgrades, refreshes, and migrations across the fleet.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the design, build, and operation of scalable, secure AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure across shared and dedicated customer environments, supporting a high-scale observability platform.

- Help integrate Observe's infrastructure into Snowflake's platforms, including CI, source control, and container platform migrations, bridging startup-era systems with enterprise-grade standards.

- Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and platform automation, moving our delivery pipeline toward GitOps and independent, safe service deployments.

- Partner with the Security team to improve access controls, secrets management, and the security posture of production environments, enabling other teams (including AI and automation initiatives) to move fast without compromising security or maintainability.

- Design and implement infrastructure patterns that ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.

- Participate in the infrastructure on-call rotation and play a key role in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements that drive systemic reliability enhancements.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to ensure infrastructure strategy supports long-term platform evolution.

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.
You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.

• Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.

• Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.

• Answer borrower, note buyer and warehouse lender questions about loans, draws, balances, payments, extensions and payoffs.

• Own each inquiry until it is resolved.

• Direct experience servicing short-term hard money or business-purpose loans.

• Experience with construction draw management, payoffs and extensions.

• Advanced written and spoken English.

• High attention to detail.

• Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.

• Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred

• Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The IT Support team helps 1Password employees get the technology they need to do their best work every day. We combine hands-on troubleshooting with modern tools, AI, and workflow automation to resolve issues and elevate the overall employee experience. As an intern on our team, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers to learn how support operations run, tackle real user requests, and help build smarter, faster support workflows.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027.

What You Can Expect:

- Ticket intake and routing: Review new Freshservice tickets for completeness, apply categories and priorities using established guidelines, and route requests to the appropriate technician or team.

- Queue maintenance: Identify unassigned, aging, duplicate, or stalled tickets; follow up with ticket owners; and flag uneven workloads for the manager’s review.

- Reporting and administrative support: Compile standard reports on ticket volume, backlog, SLA performance, and common request types; prepare summaries for team meetings while leverage AI toolkit.

- Collaborating with people across the department like IT Engineering, Enterprise Systems, IT Operations, and the Workplace Technology teams.

- User communication and follow-up: Acknowledge requests, collect missing information using approved templates, share status updates, and confirm whether users still need assistance.

What we're looking for:

- Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion.

- Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them).

- Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are.

- Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team!

Bonus points for:

- Organization and attention to detail: Keeps ticket information accurate, tracks deadlines, and follows through on outstanding tasks.

- Clear, professional communication: Writes useful ticket notes, asks focused questions, and provides courteous updates to users and technicians.

- Prioritization and sound judgment: Follows established urgency guidelines, recognizes when a ticket needs attention, and escalates appropriately.

- Basic technical literacy and willingness to learn: Understands common workplace technology and can follow troubleshooting guides and learn Freshservice workflows.

- Discretion and respect for access boundaries: Handles information carefully, follows documented procedures, and recognizes when a request requires additional discovery or authorization

title: Mission Engineer - Tampa
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable.

You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency - and to Axon.

In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account - accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production.

Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production - not product health, not activity, not slideware.

What You'll Do

This role is intentionally undefined in the day-to-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you.

Building is the job. You will use Axon's platform - AI Era, agents, workflows, integrations, and data tools - to design, build, and ship new capabilities on site. You own outcomes end to end across deployment, adoption, optimization, and ongoing success - as the accountable owner, not a coordinator of other teams' work.

Onsite Building & Platform Delivery

• Discover agency problems onsite and translate them into buildable, compliant solutions tied to mission outcomes

• Design and ship working tools on Axon's platform: AI agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and data pipelines - built and tested with real users and real data

• Build with Axon products, not around them - configure, integrate, and extend DEMS, Fusus, AI Era, Records, and related systems in the agency environment

• Iterate in the field until adoption sticks, then document patterns for reuse across accounts

• Apply responsible innovation guardrails - CJIS, evidence integrity, privacy - in every build. Ship working software, not slideware

• Troubleshoot onsite and coordinate root-cause resolution across Product, Engineering, Support, and Services when builds or integrations break

AI Build & Adoption

• Build and deploy AI-powered workflows (agents, prompts, RAG, evaluations) that solve defined agency problems - not generic experimentation

• Drive hands-on adoption with the people who use what you build daily

• Measure whether changes stick - usage, workflow impact, mission outcomes - and iterate when they don't

Operational Transformation & Leadership

• Assess workflows onsite, identify friction and mission impact, and define what to build before you build it

• Move from reactive support to proactive outcome design - arrive with hypotheses, validate with command staff and operators, then build to match

• Build trusted relationships with agency leadership and operational stakeholders; lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning

• Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed

Field Intelligence & Growth

• Capture customer insights, workflow patterns, and adoption barriers; share field intelligence with Product and En

title: Senior Reverse Engineer - Remote
description:
At Zyte , we're pioneering the next revolution in web data extraction, empowering businesses to focus on innovation. Companies often struggle with challenges like navigating dynamic web structures, countering anti-scraping measures, and ensuring data accuracy. We tackle these obstacles by providing best-in-class tools for seamless, reliable web data extraction. With over a decade of expertise, we've become the trusted solution for over 3,000 companies and a million developers, helping them achieve a competitive edge and drive sustainable growth.
We are a diverse and enthusiastic team of data nerds, tech aficionados, and hackers. At Zyte , you'll join an inclusive community where everyone belongs. We thrive on collaborating with our smart, passionate teammates and customers to solve complex problems in data science and engineering.
Join us and be part of the data revolution!

About the Job
Reverse engineering is at the heart of how Zyte stays ahead in the banning war. We've cracked some of the hardest antibots on the web - but the ground shifts weekly: antibots ship new sensor formats overnight, obfuscation schemes mutate, and new fingerprinting surfaces appear faster than any team could chase by hand.
This role is not about solving tickets one at a time. It's about building the tools, pipelines, and automation that let both engineers and AI agents solve them at scale. You will be the person who turns a reverse-engineering breakthrough into reusable tooling, who automates the investigation that used to take days into a readout that takes minutes, and who feeds the intelligence our AI systems learn from. You'll work at the intersection of deep JS/VM reverse engineering and modern AI-assisted engineering - using LLMs and agentic tooling aggressively to compress the loop between "new detection surface discovered" and "solution shipped."
If you're energized by wielding AI to multiply your own output, by automating away manual toil, and by working on problems where the adversary is smart and the target moves - this is the seat.
Requirements
Roles & Responsibilities

• Reverse-engineer the hardest antibot and fingerprinting systems on the web, across JS VMs, WASM, and polymorphic/obfuscated code.

• Build the JS function tracing, deobfuscation pipelines, and fingerprint-inspection tooling that turn manual reverse-engineering investigations into fast, repeatable, largely automated workflows.

• Use AI aggressively - LLMs, agents, and custom automation - to deobfuscate, classify, and diagnose detection surfaces, and to rapidly prototype and ship tooling that previously would have taken weeks.

• Build and maintain website intel pipelines with checkpointed history, so that when an antibot ships an update we diff against a known-good baseline instead of rediscovering the problem from scratch.

• Feed our AI reverse-engineering and ban-resolution systems the context, signals, and structured intelligence they need to autonomously resolve the majority of cases.

• Codify one-off reverse-engineering wins into durable capability - tools, rules, and pipelines usable by other engineers and by AI agents alike.

• Collaborate across engineering to fold your tooling into the custom browser and automation stack, and mentor others in AI-augmented reverse-engineering technique.

Requirements

• A hacker mindset - able to rapidly develop proof-of-concepts and working tools to get to a result, and comfortable with the inherent uncertainty and open-endedness of the work.

• Demonstrated use of AI tooling (LLMs, coding agents, automation) to accelerate your own engineering, with a strong instinct for what to automate and when.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js and Python, with a broad programming background and exceptional problem-solving ability.

• Strong research, debugging, fuzzing, and reverse-engineering skills, including static, dynamic, and concolic analysis.

• Hands-on experience reversing JavaScript VMs, WASM, and heavily obfuscated

title: Senior Revenue Systems Administrator
description:
CloudM is an award-winning SaaS platform headquartered in Manchester, with offices in London and Varna (Bulgaria), and customers in 107 countries. We help over 50,000 organisations including LinkedIn, Uber, Netflix,, and Spotify, get the most out of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, through three core products: Migrate, Automate, and Continuity.
From IT admin and onboarding to archiving and migrations, CloudM takes the complexity out of SaaS data management so our customers can focus on what matters. Backed by Marlin Equity Partners, we've grown from humble Manchester beginnings into a global business with a team of over 70 brilliant people across the UK and Europe.
If you share our ambition, we'd love you to be part of it!
Role Overview:
This is a senior, hands on role owning the systems that run CloudM ’s revenue operating model. Salesforce sits at the centre of it and you will be accountable for it. You will inherit a platform that has grown quickly alongside the business, so your job is to stabilise it, document it, rationalise the automation that has accumulated, and run it as a dependable foundation for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance as we scale.
Broadly, the shape of the role is:

• Salesforce platform ownership, remediation and day to day support: around 85%

• DealHub quoting administration: around 10%

• HubSpot maintenance and support: under 5%

You will be the only internal Salesforce specialist, with an external Salesforce partner available for deep technical work. That means you need the judgement to know what to build yourself, what to hand out, and how to hold a supplier to a standard.
This role suits someone who enjoys improving systems, asks clarifying questions before building, and is as comfortable explaining a report to a sales manager as they are rebuilding a broken flow.
Responsibilities:

• Salesforce platform ownership: Full administrative ownership of the Salesforce org. Users, permission sets, profiles and roles, objects, fields, record types, page layouts, validation rules, flows and routine maintenance, managed through sandbox with proper testing before release.

• Automation remediation: Assess the automation that exists today, rationalise it, and rebuild what is not fit for purpose. Declarative by default, code only where genuinely warranted, everything documented and supportable by someone other than you.

• Support and request management: Act as first line support for the revenue teams. Triage and prioritise the request queue, resolve to agreed timescales, and fix the cause behind repeat requests rather than the symptom.

• Quoting and deal desk: Administer DealHub so quote templates, playbooks, the product and pricing catalogue and approval workflows reflect our commercial guardrails. Maintain the DealHub to Salesforce mapping and support the sales team through quote build issues.

• Data quality and reporting: Regular audits, de duplication and health checks, plus reports and dashboards covering pipeline, funnel conversion, renewals and forecasting inputs. Understand the question behind the request and offer a view, not just the numbers.

• Integrations: Maintain the Salesforce to HubSpot sync and support Marketing’s use of the platform.

• External delivery: Own the relationship with our external Salesforce partner. Write clear requirements, challenge proposed designs, test and accept delivered work, and make sure it is documented and maintainable in house.

• Documentation and enablement: Keep system and process documentation current, produce simple guides, run drop in sessions, and promote good data habits across the business.

In your first six months we would expect the org properly documented, a prioritised remediation plan agreed with the highest risk items delivered, the support queue running to a predictable and visible standard, and DealHub quoting configuration aligned to current commercial guardrails.

title: B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) im Außendienst / Köln & Bonn
description:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Köln zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands - und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt - Praxis für Praxis.

Als B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Franken für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

Deine Aufgaben

- Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet - von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

- Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region - und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

- Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt - und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

- Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt - bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

- Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit - idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

- Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen - und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

- Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann - und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

- Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

- Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht - bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Franken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

- Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

- Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte - natürlich auch privat nutzbar

- Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote - maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

- Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

- Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

- Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

- Unser Doctolib Parent Care Programm

- Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen - darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

- Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner

title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer
description:
Mission Summary:

On our Motion Planning team, you'll apply your passion in robotics and software development for production-ready autonomous vehicles. In this role you'll perform cutting-edge research, develop advanced algorithms, and build robust software to generate safe, comfortable, and intuitive routes and motions.
Role responsibilities:

• Lead the research and development of novel algorithms for motion planning in autonomous driving, including but not limited to advanced search-based methods, sophisticated geometry-based methods, and decision making under uncertainty with a strong emphasis on probabilistic approaches.

• Architect and integrate complex combinations of motion planning and prediction algorithms, driving their evaluation and refinement for real-world deployment.

• Design and build a robust, scalable, and high-performance codebase that facilitates rapid exploration, prototyping, and rigorous evaluation of innovative motion planning approaches and algorithms.

• Drive technical collaboration and interface seamlessly with perception and prediction components upstream and trajectory optimization, tracking and control components downstream, ensuring end-to-end system performance.

• Leverage your deep software development and research expertise to teach others better software practices and principles, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

• Guide and mentor junior team members, cultivating a culture of product-focused engineering, rigorous research, and advanced development.

What we're looking for:

• PhD preferred in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; or a Master's degree with 2+ years of experience in the robotics (preferably AV industry)

• 5+ years of research experience in robotics / motion planning, with a proven track record of contributing to state-of-the-art solutions

• 3+ years of C++ software development, with an emphasis on developing high-performance and reliable systems

• Past experience owning and leading technical development on complex features from problem formulation through research, implementation, and deployment in a production environment.

• Thirst for knowledge, continuous innovation, and a drive to push the boundaries of autonomous driving technology.

Bonus points(not required):

• Experience with probabilistic models, including but not limited to Gaussian mixture models, Hidden Markov Models, and Particle Filters.

• Experience with Bayesian modeling and inference techniques for decision making under uncertainty.

• Experience with the Bazel build framework

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

Through a comprehensive global service delivery platform, REMS provides a diverse range of services, strategy and digital solutions that address the entire real estate cycle at a local to global scale for more than 500 clients in over 80 countries. JLL is committed to creating and managing environments that inspire people to do their best work.

The target candidate has delivered successful selling outcomes using structured sales processes and tools such as Miller Heiman and Salesforce. The Principal leads pursuit teams comprised of Executive Directors, Solutions, Proposals and Pricing Managers, Business Line Leaders, Service Line SMEs, Consulting and Marketing, ensuring the appropriate resources support each client engagement to maximize profitability and mitigate risk. The role requires strategic problem-solving ability and an established credibility in the Commercial Real Estate community that inspires confidence and trust.
This position can be based in any major U.S. city for ease of travel and collaboration with JLL colleagues and prospective clients.
Primary Responsibilities

title: GTM Strategy & Planning
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization helps customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products and platform.

The GTM Strategy & Planning team sits within Revenue Operations and works at the intersection of GTM Leadership, Strategic Finance, and the broader business. We shape how OpenAI invests, organizes, and scales its revenue organization, translating company ambitions into actionable growth strategies, financial targets, capacity plans, and investment decisions.

Our work spans OpenAI’s global GTM organization, including Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and emerging businesses. We partner closely with senior leadership to ensure our resources support the highest-impact opportunities as the business grows.

About the role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic operator to help shape OpenAI’s GTM growth strategy and operating plan.

In this role, you’ll tackle some of the most important questions facing our revenue organization: Where should we invest to accelerate growth? How should we allocate resources across markets, segments, and customer motions? What level of productivity can we expect as we scale? How do we translate ambitious financial goals into executable plans?

You’ll own planning and analytical workstreams spanning revenue targets, investment strategy, capacity and productivity modeling, and GTM organizational design. Working closely with Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, and cross-functional partners, you’ll develop rigorous, data-backed recommendations that inform executive decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with strategic judgment, thrives in ambiguity, and can move between detailed modeling and executive-level decision-making.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with GTM Leadership and Strategic Finance to translate company financial objectives into growth strategies, resource allocation decisions, and operating plans across regions, segments, and functions.

- Build headcount, capacity, and productivity models to inform where and how OpenAI invests across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM functions.

- Develop regional, segment, and team-level revenue targets, translating company financial goals into executable plans with clear accountability.

- Build scenario analyses to evaluate how hiring, productivity, product launches, partner distribution, and other growth levers affect revenue performance and investment requirements.

- Develop data-driven recommendations on segmentation, coverage models, organizational structure, and resource allocation to support growth and operational efficiency.

- Lead annual and midyear planning cycles, aligning Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, Field Operations, Data Science, and other stakeholders around a cohesive operating plan.

- Analyze revenue attainment, capacity, productivity, and other key performance indicators to surface risks, challenge assumptions, and inform strategic decisions.

- Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership, balancing analytical rigor with business judgment and a company-wide perspective.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 8+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, management consulting, or a similarly analytical and strategic role.

- Have exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience building complex models that inform strategic, financial, and operational decisions.

- Understand GTM strategy, revenue planning, capacity models, and the drivers of growth and productivity in high-growth technology businesses.

- Have experience with SaaS, consumption-based, or usage-based business models and understand how different GTM motions influence revenue growth

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations. You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

- Build and evolve the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

- Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

- Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

- Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

- Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

- Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

- Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

 

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

- Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

- Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

- Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

- Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

- Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

- Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

- Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

- Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

- Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

 

Nice to Have:

- Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

- Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

- Experience with model routing, AI
